name: Large Variable-Geometry Turbo
notes: Larger VGT compressor and turbine stage raising boost ceiling to 3.05 PR and mass-flow choke to 0.56 kg/s for high-fuel top-end headroom, at the cost of later spool (full boost at 2300 vs. 1800 RPM) and softer low-RPM response.

name: High-Flow Injectors (+30%)
notes: Extrude-honed +30% solenoid injectors raising the per-stroke delivery ceiling from 120 to 156 mm³; adds no power unless a tune commands more than 120 mm³, and requires a stroker CP3 pump to sustain rail supply at high RPM.

name: Stroker CP3 High-Pressure Pump
notes: Longer-stroke cam-ring CP3 pump increasing high-RPM fuel mass flow while retaining the published 23,000 psi LLY rail-pressure ceiling; supporting fuel-supply hardware that adds no output unless the stock pump cap was binding.

name: Tow Tune
notes: Mild ECM calibration adding mid-range pulling torque with a conservative 18.5:1 clean-burn AFR floor and 1450 °F EGT ceiling; on stock hardware the stock turbo caps boost at 2.50 PR and EGT trims peak-torque fuel slightly.

name: Performance Tune
notes: Aggressive street/strip ECM calibration requesting 2.90 PR boost and sustained high-RPM fueling (up to 118 mm³ mid-range, 112 mm³ at 3000 RPM); on stock hardware it saturates the stock turbo and hits the 1450 °F EGT wall across 1100–3000 RPM.

name: High-Flow Intake
notes: Open-element airbox and smoother compressor inlet tube adding +6% breathing capacity; does not move peak torque or peak power on the stock tune because stock peaks are fuel-request-limited, only loosening the low-RPM smoke cap slightly at 1000 RPM.

name: 4-Inch Exhaust System
notes: Mandrel-bent 4-inch turbo-back exhaust reducing turbine backpressure for a +5% breathing multiplier; lowers EGT and supports tuned builds, with near-zero peak gain on a stock fuel-limited calibration.

name: Upgraded Intercooler
notes: Bar-and-plate charge-air cooler raising thermal effectiveness from 0.78 to 0.85 for denser intake air and greater EGT margin under high boost; adds no peak power until fueling is raised enough for air or EGT caps to bind.

name: Ported Cylinder Heads
notes: CNC-ported 32-valve aluminum cylinder heads providing +8% port airflow to raise trapped air mass and push back the EGT ceiling on heavily fueled builds; produces no peak gain on an untuned stock fuel table.

name: Performance Camshaft
notes: Reprofiled gear-driven camshaft adding +4% volumetric efficiency across the rev range to increase trapped air and EGT headroom on tuned builds; does not change output where fuel request is already the binding limit.

name: Low-Compression Forged Pistons (16.5:1)
notes: De-lipped forged pistons dropping static compression from 17.5:1 to 16.5:1 to manage peak cylinder pressure under high boost; a supporting mod requiring the large turbo that costs ~1.2% brake thermal efficiency at equal fuel.

name: Heavy-Duty Forged Connecting Rods
notes: Billet/forged chromoly connecting rods built for high-cylinder-pressure bottom-end durability; changes no number computed by the steady-state performance model.
